column3: “Gather yourselves together and gather together” is rendered “Gather yourselves together, yes, gather”; “not ashamed” is rendered “without shame.”
“Brings forth a decree” is rendered “the decree takes effect”; NASB renders “like chaff a day has passed” as “The day passes like the chaff.” The meaning is uncertain.
“People will drive it out” is rendered “Ashdod will be driven out,” and “plucked up” “uprooted.”
“Region of the sea” is rendered “seacoast”; “from not inhabitant” is rendered “So that there will be no inhabitant.”
“Meadows of shepherds” is rendered “caves for shepherds”; the Hebrew word is uncertain.
“Visit” is rendered “care for,” and “turn back their captivity” “restore their fortune.”
“Reproach” is rendered “taunting,” and “people of Ammon” “sons of Ammon”; “magnified themselves on” is rendered “become arrogant against.”
“A pit of salt” is rendered “salt pits,” and “until perpetuity” “perpetual”; “take possession of” is rendered “inherit.”
“In place of” is rendered “in return for,” and “reproached” “taunted.”
“Awesome” is rendered “terrifying,” “make lean” “starve,” and “islands” “coastlands”; “if” is rendered “for.”
“Are those slain of my sword” is rendered “will be slain by My sword.”

“Herds, every animal of a nation” is rendered “flocks … All beasts which range in herds”; “desert owl” is rendered “pelican,” and “a sound will sing” “Birds will sing.” The meaning of several words is uncertain.
“Jubilant” is rendered “exultant,” and “I and only I am yet” “I am, and there is no one besides me”; NASB adds “in contempt.”
